## agentckpt v0.1.0

Checkpoint a working tree while coding agents run, and restore any snapshot **without touching your git branches or index**.

### Why

Coding agents edit and delete files. `/undo` is often missing or unreliable ([openai/codex#9203](https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/9203)). agentckpt keeps a private shadow store under `.agentckpt/` so you can snap and restore freely.

### Install

```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/Blackman99/agentckpt agentckpt demo
pipx install git+https://github.com/Blackman99/agentckpt
```

### Commands

`init` · `snap` · `watch` · `ls` · `diff` · `restore` · `prune` · `doctor` · `demo`

Docs: https://blackman99.github.io/agentckpt/docs/
